reports.title: Unum Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: As noted above, we have revised our definition of after-tax adjusted operating income. Incorporating the annual assumption review and refinements, our results through the first three quarters, and our fourth-quarter expectations for the core segments, we now expect full-year 2026 after-tax adjusted operating income per share of $8.30 to $8.50, which includes approximately $0.33 from the notable item.
